**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity) at Section 6.1 (p0037).**

- **Issue:** Section 6.1 binds *us* (the Company) not to "participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet" with respect to Deerskin Products *or* "products substantially similar" *or* products of unnamed "companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled" — an undefined field-of-use restriction on our own merchandising business, with no carve-out for product development or acquisitions.
- **Direction check:** The mirror covenant in Section 6.3 binds HDI (and runs two years post-term) — acceptable, left untouched. Section 6.2's closeout carve-out is preserved.
- **Resolution (fallback applied):** Because HDI bears all design, development and hosting costs for a dedicated "Deerskin" site, outright deletion would be disproportionate. The redline narrows the covenant to a self-contained "Deerskin"-branded consumer web site, term-only, with express carve-outs for other channels (catalogs, retail, marketplaces), product development/sourcing, and M&A — while leaving HDI's exclusive "Deerskin" brand right for the Site intact.
